verdict.rationale: stagewise is documented as a standalone desktop IDE, and its inline and side-by-side diff review runs inside stagewise itself, not inside JetBrains. The GitHub README mentions a generic 'IDE integration to view and apply code changes in your favorite editor', and settings let you choose the editor for opening files. Neither names JetBrains or shows interactive diffs or sharing selected code as agent context from within a JetBrains IDE, so this is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
